title.native: ブルーアーカイブ The Animation

description:
The anime will adapt the "Countermeasures Committee" arc.

The city's academies are divided into their own districts and are considered mostly independent.

The General Student Council acts as governing board to manage the academies as a whole. However, the group's ability to govern has come to halt since the mysterious disappearance of the General Student Council president. Countless issues have begun to surface throughout Kivotos in the absence of the president's leadership.

To avoid disaster, the General Student Council requests assistance from the Federal Investigation Club, otherwise known as Schale. In fact, Schale is the city's newest club and the last to be approved before the president's disappearance.

To accomplish its task, Schale relies on the guidance of a Sensei who can help them resolve the incidents around Kivotos.

(Students are required to carry personal weapons and smart phones! Get a taste of the military action, love, and friendship the Academy City has to offer!)

(Source: Anime News Network, Nexon, edited)

__Academy:__ Abydos High School
__Year: __3rd Year
__Height:__ 145cm (4'9")

Vice president of the Abydos Student Council and president of the Foreclosure Task Force.

Acts like a tired old timer, and would rather play pranks and nap than do actual work. This often gets her in trouble with her fellow task force members, but once she's on a mission, she fights on the frontlines harder than anyone else to keep her friends safe.

Hoshino's hobbies include napping and procrastinating.

__Academy:__ Gehenna Academy
__Year:__ 3rd Year
__Height:__ 142cm (4'7")

Hina Sorasaki is a 3rd year student and the current chairwoman of Gehenna's Prefect Team, who is rightfully feared by every student in the academy, if not all of Kivotos. She is a troublesome, laid-back person, and calls it a "hassle" when she talks about school rules. However, she's still strict while at the academy, and enacts calm and quick judgment without hesitation on the battlefield. Her fighting prowess is astounding and for that reason, any organization that opposes Gehenna is more afraid of her than anyone else from the Prefect Team.

__Academy:__ Abydos High School
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Shiroko is a member of the Countermeasures Committee and the deuteragonist. She is the sports-loving field captain of the Abydos High School and a girl of few words, who rarely shows her emotions. Despite her aloof appearance, Shiroko deeply cares about Abydos High School and is willing to do anything to help her friends towards their goal of revitalizing the school. Shiroko is a soft-spoken girl who cares deeply for her friends. She is generally calm and reserved but can hyperfocus on certain interests, sometimes becoming oblivious to how others would react to them. She often bikes and walks distances of 10s of kilometers, which she considers average.

Aru is a 2nd year student from Gehenna Academy and she wields a Sniper Rifle as her weapon of choice.

She is the self-proclaimed leader and a member of the Club Problem Solver 68.

__Academy:__ Millennium Science School
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Height:__ 5'1"

The treasurer of Seminar, the student council of the Millennium Science School.

Yuuka has a mathematical acumen that is notable even among Millennium's high ratio of STEM students. She oversees the entirety of Millennium's budget. Her special talent is the abacus, and she has a habit of fiddling with the beads when dealing with emotional or mental conflicts.

The "section chief" of Problem Solver 68 and a 3rd year student at Gehenna Academy. 

Unlike the other members of Problem Solver 68, though, Kayoko is not one with ill intentions. However, she is often misunderstood as a delinquent simply due to her naturally intimidating facial expressions and appearance. She normally prefers to keep silent about this topic, as it likely leads to furthering her terrifying image.

A 2nd year student at Gehenna Academy, Mutsuki holds the title of "Chief of staff" and is the assault activist and go-getter of Problem Solver 68.

Contrary to her guilt-riddled childhood friend [Aru](https://anilist.co/character/260206/Rikuhachima-Aru), she is a devilish troublemaker and commits acts of wanton wrongdoing without hesitation. No one can read Aru better than Mutsuki, so she understands her friend's bluff better than anyone else, even if she doesn't give any particular thought to the matter. While Aru understand's her bravado better than anyone else in Kivotos, she does not necessarily support her oldest friend's devilish personality.
Academy: Abydos High School Year: 1st Year Height: 5'0"

Arona is a self-proclaimed high-performance AI who serves as the OS of the Shittim Chest. She resides in a desolate classroom located in the midst of a watery expanse, stretching further than the eye can see. When she's not helping Sensei with their tasks, she's up to goofy antics that appear on Arona Channel.

She has a child-like personality and is quite gullible, often falling for Sensei's jokes. Arona thoroughly enjoys sweets, being quick to abandon a diet for the sake of sweets—or even breaking into tears from being denied them.

**Height**: 158 cm
**Academy**: Trinity General School 
**Year**: 2nd Year

An emotional and sensitive girl in the Supplementary Lesson Department of Trinity General Academy. Despite her average grades and appearance, Hifumi's gentle and kind personality has gained her popularity. While she will gladly lend an ear to those with problems, she has a tendency to be swept up in the moment and unintentionally cause trouble.

Hifumi is notably very kind and friendly even to strangers to a point of willing to assist them (even going along with their shenanigans without protesting). The most unusual thing about her at first glance is her obsession with Momo and Friends, specifically Peroro. She's willing to risk her life and comfort in order to do anything Peroro, with the prime example being willing to go to the Black Market to get limited-edition merchandise.

__Academy:__ Trinity General School
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Height:__ 4'10"

A member of Trinity's make up work club

Koharu was originally part of the Justice Task Force, but was forced to transfer to the make up work club due to poor grades which put her at risk of flunking. Despite thinking of herself as an elite, she struggles to keep up with her classes. Koharu reads racy material for fun, and gets dirty ideas from the most trivial things, which ends with her embarrassing herself.

Her hobbies include, fantasizing, daydreaming and reading raunchy material.

__Height:__ 149 cm
__Academy:__ Trinity General School
__Year:__ 2nd Year

An ice queen who belongs to Trinity's Supplementary Lessons Department.

Originally, she had dropped out of her school, but for one reason or another, she has returned to school and is working on her schoolwork again. She is lonely, but she voluntarily keeps her distance for fear of bothering others and is worried by the students in Supplementary Lessons Department.

**Academy:** Gehenna Academy
**Year**: 2nd Year

Enrolled in Gehenna Academy, Iori is a ruthless specialist of the Public Morals Committee. As the leader of its assault corps, she punishes students that she finds breaking the rules with overwhelming force. While she may be quick-thinking, good at her job and possessing a decent sense of combat, Iori is also prone to losing sight of her surroundings once she spots an enemy. This recklessness can lead to her falling into even the simplest of traps.

__Academy:__ Abydos High School
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Height:__ 5'2"

Izayoi Nonomi is one of the students studying in Abydos High School who wields a Machine Gun with green accents and the Abydos insignia.

She has an emotional and gentle personality, and she serves as a mental support for the Committee, many of whom have extreme personalities. Despite not mentioning it herself, she comes from a wealthy family, and most of the snacks for the Council are funded by her.

__Academy:__ Millennium Science School
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Height:__ 143cm (4'8")

The scenario writer for the Game Development Department at Millennium. Both she and her younger twin sister, Midori are in charge of developing video games for the group. Although her cheerful personality is the polar opposite to her shy sister, their passion for games are strikingly similar, which make them both great partners.

A teacher with a strange affinity for military tactics, Sensei is the advisor for SCHALE. With the help of Arona and the students of various academies, Sensei keeps the peace in Kivotos while getting into wacky antics with the city's students, guiding them to be better while getting closer to them.  

In-game, Sensei is the player's self-insert character, allowing the player to imagine their sex or any appearance they want for themselves.

A student of Gehenna Academy, Ako is the executive officer of the Disciplinary Committee, and a sort-of secretary to its president Hina. At first glance she may appear kind and good-natured, but Ako has zero tolerance for students who break the rules. She is constantly at Hina's side, assisting in her duties as president of the Disciplinary Committee. This has prompted other students to call her "Hina's Pet" amongst other things, but Ako doesn't particulary care.

__Academy:__ Gehenna Academy
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Height:__ 157 cm (5’1”)

Haruka is a rank-and-file member of Gehenna Academy's Problem Solver 68. Due to her gloomy personality, she has always been teased, but was able to escape that fate thanks to Aru. Afterwards she has operated in Problem Solver 68 as a role akin to the youngest child in a family. 

Despite her shyness and little self-esteem, it wouldn't be incorrect in saying she's the scariest among the erratic Problem Solver 68.

__Academy:__Millennium Science School
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Height:__161 cm (5'3")

Member of the Millennium Science School, secretary of the "Seminar" student council.

Noa mainly records seminar decisions and meeting minutes, and is also in charge of the patent attorney's duties of identifying and registering patents for products developed by Millennium students. She has a very good memory and can almost perfectly memorize whatever she sees and hears once.
A serious treasurer of Abydos's Countermeasures Committee. The type of girl who values principles and rules, she does her earnest to restore Abydos High.

__Academy:__ Millennium Science School
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Height:__ 143cm (4'8")

She is the illustrator for the Game Development Department, and works alongside her twin sister Momoi to develop video games. She is very shy and reserved, in contrast to her sister's cheerful and excitable demeanor. Despite their differences, they have unrivaled passion in working together when it comes to games, and have grown close as a result.

Affiliated with Trinity General Academy, she is the leader of "Filius", one of the student union bodies that make up Trinity, and the host of the "Tea Party" student council.

Nagisa is refined and soft-spoken, but rarely reveals her true feelings, making her a complicated and mysterious character. Her hobby is preparing tea leaves and sweets for tea parties. She dreams of a day when many Trinity students would be invited to a tea party of hers.

__Age:__ ~!17!~

A mysterious individual whose appearance is unmistakably that of a familiar student, but is not quite the same. A Nameless Goddess who made contact with the Iridescence, leading it to Kivotos, and consequently, Kivotos' demise.

~!This version of Shiroko was one who had fallen into despair after the loss of her friends and Sensei, believing herself to have killed the latter. Ridden with guilt, she arrives in the current timeline to fulfill the role of bringing the world to its predetermined end. However, she hesitates upon being aware of familiar faces she never wanted see again...!~

Academy: Gehenna 
Year: 1st Year
Height: 159 cm (5'2")

Former student council president of Abydos High School. Has a very kind and positive personality, although to her own detriment. 

~![Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/264242/Hoshino-Takanashi) current attire is based off what Yume wore in the past.!~
